subject: general
question: The first national flag of India is said to have hoisted at _______ in 1906.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The first national flag in India is said to have been hoisted on **7th August 1906.**
 
• It was hoisted in the Parsee Bagan Square (Green Park) in **Kolkata.**__
 
• The flag was composed of three horizontal strips of red, yellow and green.
 
• The second flag was hoisted by **Madame Bhikaji Cama in 1907** at Stuttgart, Germany.
 
• The third flag was hoisted in **1917.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• A resolution was passed adopting a tricolour flag as our national flag in **1931.**
 
• The constituent assembly adopted the national flag on** 22nd July 1947. **
 
• The shape of the National Flag of India shall be **rectangular.**
 
• The ratio of length to width(height) of the flag shall be** 3:2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's national flag is a tricolour panel made up of three rectangular panels or sub-panels of equal widths
 
 
• The top panel of the national flag is India saffron (Kesaria) and that of the bottom is India green.
 
• The middle panel is white.
 
• The centre of the white panel consists of an Ashoka Chakra in navy blue colour with 24 equally spaced spokes.
